about: Boss signature mechanics (Dom + Strategy 2026-10-28: each boss has its own fighting identity). A MAP: mechanic id -> that mechanic's row; data/rings.json bosses[].mechanic names one id, src/fight/mechanics/registry.ts holds the code for each id (one line per mechanic), src/sim/validate.js checkMechanics checks the shape and each module checks its own row. Every number a mechanic uses is a row here, never a constant in code. reginald-limb-loss (Sir Reginald, profile castle-guard): as he takes damage his armour fails limb by limb. `limbs[]`: `id` the tag kept on his fighter (`limb:<id>` in Fighter.phases, the sim's own sticky list, so a new fight starts whole); `region` the cut manifest region (src/assets/castle-guard-106.cut.manifest.json) whose `piece` mesh disappears and whose `stumpCaps` show; `name` the words the caption says; `belowPct` his health share (0..100) under which it fails; `speedMult` his pace multiplier from then on (1 = none); `forbids` the actions he can no longer throw, each thrown as `swapTo` instead; `hitStopMs` the freeze on the tick it fails (the tell, with the caption, data/commentator.json events.limb_loss). The counter: keep the pressure on (each limb costs him a family of moves) or fight on; nothing here changes a hit row.
